title: Making R run Fast - Jan Vitek
summary: Jan Vitek of Northeastern University gives a meetup talk on the challenges of making the R language run fast. He explains what in R's semantics makes it hard to optimize and to build a JIT compiler for.
why: HN points to it as the best explanation of why R is so hard to optimize, often paired with talks on Python and used to explain what makes Julia fast.

quote.text: Another talk on the difficulty of optimising R is this fantastic one by Jan Vitek
